messages:
Raj: Quick RFC follow-up: split precision profiles into 'capabilities' (immutable signed artifact) + 'runtime_hint' (mutable). Keeps guarantees stable and gives ops quick control.

Anika: How do we keep per-layer calibs? Many customers rely on them.

Marta: Adapter at deploy-time: expand capability -> per-layer profile. Cache keyed by (cap_hash, adapter_ver). Runtime unchanged.

Chris: We must ship telemetry: lane-specific deg_score, tokenwise SNR, prompt-cohort deltas, and shadow sampling traceability.

Sam: Storage: content-addressed capabilities (sha256). Human aliases OK but not canonical.

Jules: Who can set runtime_hint? Customer hint, ops_override, SRE policy?

Raj: Plan = customer_hint (opt-in), ops_override (account-scoped, auditable), policy_hysteresis (SRE-driven auto demote). Resolve by policy, choose most conservative.

Anika: Need operator API to increase shadow_sample_rate per-tenant during ramps.

Marta: Add account flag safe_mode to disable lowbit lanes for regulated tenants unless exception signed.

Chris: Canary plan: 72h shadowing + staged ramp 1/5/25/50/100% with auto-rollback on deg_score/latency triggers. SRE owns hysteresis numbers.

Sam: API ergonomics: precision=auto|fp8|int8|float16 + quality_budget param. Example usage in client docs.

Raj: Owners: Raj(adapter), Anika(telemetry), SRE/Chris(canary), Sam(API). I'll open adapter PR by Wed.

sre-bot: scheduled canary window 1829997850 — will create env and post updates.

Anika: I'll make dashboards and alerts before canary. Raj: include audit logging hooks for ops_override.

Raj: Agreed. Meeting Friday to track progress.
